title: Sintel (2010, Blender Foundation, dir. Colin Levy)
synopsis: A lone girl rescues and raises a wounded baby dragon, Scales, until an adult dragon snatches it. She searches for years, finally reaches a dragon's lair, and kills the adult dragon that hesitated to kill her, then sees its wing scar: it was Scales, grown up. Her reflection shows she has grown up too. Scales' baby follows her as she leaves.
notes: Footage-verified in this run (277 shots analysed). Official 1080p/4K masters exist; the copy reachable from the restricted test network is a 512x292 re-encode (CC-BY permits redistribution).
